idea: A little robot waters a seed for three days and nights and nothing comes up; on the fourth morning a sprout shows, and it blooms
leave: Keep tending what you care about, even when nothing shows yet
subject: the mound of earth

device.what: the sun and the moon crossing the sky over one small mound
device.why: the days going by without change are the waiting; the mound is where the change comes

change.from: the first morning, the robot watering a bare mound
change.to: three days and nights have passed and the mound is still bare

change.from: the fourth morning, a bare mound
change.to: a green sprout stands in it
it is hopping, the flower is open and the words 发芽了 have appeared
